title: Nvidia Shield TV Pro price rises 50% seven years after launch due to AI memory shortage
summary: The veteran streaming device sees its price go from $199 to $299 due to growing demand for memory chips driven by artificial intelligence.

title: OpenAI safety researchers resign en masse warning of broken culture and demand nuclear-style regulation
summary: Several key employees leave the company alleging that safety is sacrificed for speed and demand that AI labs be managed like nuclear facilities.

title: AMD developed a Ryzen 9 5900X3D with 128 MB of L3 cache that never reached the market
summary: An engineering sample reveals AMD created a Zen 3 processor with double the 3D V-Cache of the 5800X3D, but decided not to commercialize it.

title: Steam breaks records with $1.7 billion in September 2026 despite hardware price increases
summary: Valve's platform reaches historic revenue and approaches 21,000 annual releases, on track to surpass $20 billion annually.

title: Federal judge declares Flock license plate reader mass surveillance unconstitutional
summary: A court labels the system 'indiscriminate surveillance' as AOC and Bernie Sanders introduce a bill to ban license plate readers.

title: Connectors on a $5,245 prebuilt RTX 5090 melt after a year in the box
summary: A user discovers the 12VHPWR connectors on their high-end graphics card have melted without ever being used, reigniting debate over the power standard.

title: Amazon fills Aragon with data centers but pays taxes in Madrid, sparking revolt from affected municipalities
summary: El Burgo de Ebro and Villanueva de Gállego denounce that the company does not pay taxes locally despite enormous resource consumption, while Amazon promises 1 billion for nearby communities.
